taglines: Monday. The weekend called. It said it needs space. It's not coming back.
You set three alarms. You snoozed all three. You set a fourth. The fourth was a formality. You are ungovernable.
The standup is in 10 minutes. You have accomplished nothing. You will say 'still working on that ticket' and everyone will believe you. This is civilization.
Coffee: consumed. Slack: open. Motivation: listed as 'coming soon.' The Jira ticket has been in 'In Progress' since February and you are not sorry.
Your 'quick sync' has a pre-meeting to align on the agenda. The agenda is: why do we have so many meetings. No one sees it.
GPT said it would take 30 minutes. Claude said 20. You've been debugging the AI's output for six hours. The simulation is eating itself.
You shipped. Nothing broke. You are suspicious. You refresh the error dashboard. You will not sleep until something goes wrong. Something will go wrong.
Monday is just a social construct. Unfortunately, so is your paycheck. See you in the standup.
